name: salesforce-ehnancer
description: Developer tool for Salesforce, designed to help and speed up what the developer has to do!

scripts.copy:public: cpx "src/public/*.{html,css,json,js}" dist/public -u && cpx "src/public/icons/*" dist/public/icons -u --include-empty-dirs && cpx "src/public/images/*" dist/public/images -u --include-empty-dirs
scripts.pre:copy: npm run copy:public && npm run copy:dvcs && npm run copy:dvcs:modal
scripts.pre:repack: npm run build && npm run pack
scripts.watch: npm run build:tsc && npm run pre:watch
scripts.build: npm run build:tsc && npm run pre:build
scripts.pack: npm run build:tsc && npm run pre:pack
scripts.repack: npm run build:tsc && npm run pre:repack
scripts.format: npm run build:tsc && npm run pre:format
